material and chemistry, including phenol modification and polymer concentration
uncrosslinked precursor versus crosslinked gel state
formulation_id, independently prepared batch_id, test_run_id and replicate/averaging role
temperature and steady-flow operator, scan direction, preshear/equilibration and instrument geometry where reported
native positive unique shear-rate coordinates and units, with coordinate-only support gate
traceable measured viscosity values distinct from fitted/digitized/generated predictions
file-specific access/reuse terms and exact source-file hash
unit overlap crosswalk against original45 and all four consumed sources
confirmation versus calibration versus exploratory roles assigned by independent units before any targets are revealed

permitted_reopen_conditions: A newly identified public native steady-flow file with exact provenance and compatible unreacted precursor state
A genuinely new source version explicitly adds previously unconsumed independent formulation/preparation units, with old-to-new crosswalk
Author supplies previously unused native measured curves and batch metadata plus permissible access and an agreed pre-target role split
recommendation: Preserve the current retrospective-development and transfer claims. Independent same-domain calibration/confirmation needs new eligible units; do not widen old curves after looking at targets and call that independent calibration. Further public searching is possible only as a separately bounded scope, with no claim that the current pass exhausted the internet.
claims_boundary: A transparent narrow-domain development manuscript need not establish every possible generalization claim. This source gate only limits stronger independent-batch and calibration claims; it does not estimate MLST acceptance probability.
